What’s inside?
The view from the field
We speak to experts from universities,
businesses, and funds to discover how they
use equity funding in combination with
Innovate UK grants
University ranking
Universities are ranked by both number of
IUK-funded projects and total IUK grant
funding.
Equity investment
When used together with grant funding,
equity investment has significant effects
on company valuations.
Regional distribution
Both equity and grant finance are
regionally concentrated. We look at every
region in the UK.
